value.body: A marketing analyst measures how campaigns, channels and offers perform, using sales, website and customer data. Consumer brands, e-commerce firms, agencies and analytics companies hire them. A typical day involves pulling data, updating dashboards, and explaining what changed and why.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BBA (Business Analytics), B.Com, BBA or a statistics degree

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Excel, SQL, a BI tool, web analytics platforms

items.label: BBA enrolment (all modes)
items.note: All specialisations; AISHE does not separate Business Analytics
items.source: AISHE 2023-24 (Ministry of Education), Table 11, actual responses

items.label: Advertising revenue in India
items.note: Digital advertising ~₹94,700 crore, ~63% of the total (as reported)
items.source: FICCI-EY M&E report 2026 (as reported, EY press release)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers often join as a junior analyst in an analytics firm, agency or the marketing team of a consumer business. A portfolio of small projects (for example, a dashboard or a campaign analysis) helps in interviews.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Excel and SQL for data pulls

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: senior analyst, growth or performance marketing roles, analytics manager.
Data privacy rules increasingly shape what customer data can be used.
The skills overlap with data analyst roles, so moving between the two is common.

competition.note: BBA graduates in 2023-24 at institutions that reported to AISHE — everyone finishing that degree, not only those entering this role.
competition.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 34 (programme-wise out-turn), Ministry of Education

women.note: Share of women among BBA graduates in 2023-24 — the entry degree, not people already working in this role.
women.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 34 (programme-wise out-turn), Ministry of Education
